summary: Two challenges: The Real World (multimodal and physical-world data) and Agents That Ship (useful end-to-end agents). Includes a named Saint bounty.
eligibility: Developers, founders, researchers and students via guaranteed-entry, ballot and student-approval tickets. Ticket prices, age and international admission unverified.
title: Encode London Hackathon

prize.description: Best Use of Saint bounty: GBP 200 cash, Saint access for each teammate and three months free. Other prizes not verified.

notes: 23–25 October at Encode Hub, 41 Pitfield Street; demos on Sunday 25 October.
